text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Yamanin Zephyr and Tokai Teio, one of her peers, talk about each other's goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Teio wants to become an undefeated Triple Crown champion like her own "Emperor," Symboli Rudolf, who pulled off an astounding victory at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zephyr, on the other hand, looks up to the Mile Emperor. Although their role models differ, the two bond over their shared feelings of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their paths are set to diverge, with Zephyr in the mile tour and Teio in the Triple Crown tour, but they view each other as rivals nonetheless.
